note: GD.41 include-style mounts, Flask. svc/items.py declares `bp = Blueprint("items", __name__)` with no url_prefix; app.py imports it (`from svc.items import bp`) and mounts it with `app.register_blueprint(bp, url_prefix="/svc")`, so its routes are /svc/items and /svc/items/<int:item_id>. svc/orders.py's blueprint carries its own `url_prefix="/orders"` and is registered by module attribute (`orders.orders`) with no url_prefix, so its own prefix applies. The TS client calls a non-`/api` prefix, so the resolver's default `api` strip cannot pair them: only the mount does.
